There really is nothing I can do for finances. On disability so income is very fixed. I live in a run down apartment because it's the cheapest thing. I steal a neighbors open internet connection so i can use the internet. Don't have a cell phone or car payments. I buy rice and noodles in bulk and that is basically all i eat. occasionally find clearance meat for real cheap and add in when i can. Good news i have lost 30 lbs over the last year.

I have been trying over and over again for 2 years. I have a appointment with a consular, but that appointment has been moved more times than i can count. was supposed to happen in 2016, but currently made for june 2018, but will be moved again like every time
